question: What is the primary purpose of the 'Bhargavastra system' developed in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Countering swarm drone threats**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Bhargavastra system** is a sophisticated defense technology developed and unveiled in **May 2025** specifically to mitigate the growing dangers of **swarm drone attacks**.
 
• Its primary function is **Countering swarm drone threats**, which involve multiple autonomous or semi-autonomous unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) acting in coordination to saturate and bypass traditional air defense systems. ***Hence, the correct answer is Countering swarm drone threats.***
 
• The system utilizes **Directed Energy Weapon (DEW)** technology, allowing it to target and neutralize several drones simultaneously through **electromagnetic pulses** rather than relying on individual kinetic projectiles.
 
• Developed as part of modernizing **asymmetric warfare** capabilities, the **Bhargavastra system** provides a **low-cost-per-kill** solution against mass-produced, inexpensive drone units.
